## Citing the software {.unnumbered}

Cite the R packages you use, as well as R itself. Version numbers matter
because results and defaults can change between versions. Each package
supplies its own reference, and the version printed is the one you have
installed:

```r
citation()               # R itself
citation("survival")     # Kaplan-Meier, log-rank, Cox models
citation("survminer")    # pairwise_survdiff()
citation("ggsurvfit")    # KM plots
citation("MatchIt")      # propensity score matching
citation("cobalt")       # balance tables and Love plots
sessionInfo()            # every package version, for your records
```

The **grateful** package can create a formatted list of package citations
for a manuscript automatically: `grateful::cite_packages()`.
